pages.title: Getting Airborne
pages.text: To fly, you first need to look impressive—scratch that.$(br2)A Control Seat cannot do anything by itself. Complete these steps to assemble a working flight system:$(br2)1. Link at least one valid peripheral of each required type to the Control Seat: a thruster, a battery, and a fuel tank.

2. Fill the fuel tank with a valid thruster fuel; see the $(l:vsie:thruster/basic_info)Thrusters/$ chapter. Use any pipe that can actively insert fluid, including a Mechanical Pump, or right-click the tank with a fuel bucket. With only AeroIE installed, thrusters accept D-T Fuel and High-Energy Particle Fuel. E-710 is warp fuel and cannot power ordinary propulsion.$(br2)3. Charge the battery with any cable capable of transferring FE.
4. Right-click the Control Seat. If everything is configured correctly, you can now fly until the vessel runs out of energy or fuel.$(br2)For detailed operation, see Control Seat: Flight Controls.
